sample_unit: standardized clinical vignettes (queried across 6 LLMs by 6 investigators, plus 3 repeated iterations per vignette)

links.outcome: Reproducibility of dosing recommendations across repeated runs of the same prompt by the same user
links.effect: Variance in daily maintenance doses recommended across repeated iterations ranged from 0 to 1000%.
links.quote: LLMs produced variable responses to the same user upon multiple iterations, with variance in daily maintenance doses recommended ranging from 0 to 1000%.

links.outcome: Concordance of LLM antibiotic dosing recommendations with primary literature
links.effect: Mean concordance with literature-based recommendations was 63% (range 28%-94%); dosing recommendations varied widely.
links.quote: Mean concordance with literature-based recommendations was 63% (range: 28%-94%).

links.outcome: Citation accuracy versus confabulation in LLM dosing rationales
links.effect: OpenEvidence universally cited relevant sources, whereas other LLMs leveraged sources inconsistently or confabulated them.
links.quote: OpenEvidence universally cited relevant sources, whereas other LLMs leveraged sources inconsistently or confabulated them.

links.outcome: Acknowledgment of uncertainty in LLM dosing outputs
links.effect: Each LLM recommended TDM, though only Claude consistently acknowledged its own uncertainty.
links.quote: Each recommended TDM, though only Claude consistently acknowledged its own uncertainty.

links.outcome: Accuracy and consistency of free LLM dosing recommendations that clinicians might act on
links.effect: Freely available LLMs produced highly variable and often discordant antibiotic dosing recommendations for AKI/CKRT patients; outputs should not be used in isolation.
links.quote: Freely available LLMs produce highly variable and often discordant antibiotic dosing recommendations for patients with AKI and receiving CKRT.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, consistency, and citation validity of multiple LLMs on clinical vignettes regarding precision drug dosing for kidney impairment.
